fieldValues.title: D5 Portable semantic publication
fieldValues.summary: A publication carries the definition closure, canonical Records and Relations, provenance/completeness diagnostics and a generic readable facet; a later user can continue it without silent loss.
fieldValues.body:
## Group Need

We need another person or tool to take a document, its definitions and its readable meaning elsewhere without depending on our website or editor.

## Semantic Adds

- self-contained definition closure
- publication completeness declaration
- portable document lineage

## Blueprint Adds

- offline-reader walkthrough
- whole-document continuation review

## Does Not Introduce

- a promise that every attachment is included without a declaration
- federation negotiation
- a proprietary publication reader

## Activation Trigger

A document must remain usable and explainable after leaving the system that authored or published it.

## Research

- problem-index/09-distribution/repository-slices.md: Portable subsets need explicit identity, closure, provenance-completeness and import semantics rather than a bespoke export format.
